blind.description: A stylized wooden tailor's display shelf unit with four corner posts and multiple shelves. The top shelf holds a red brimmed hat on a stand, a dark green folded cloth, a cream folded blanket, and a rolled red bolt of fabric. The interior shelves are neatly stocked with colorful rolled and folded textiles in red, purple, green, yellow, and cream, along with a small display stand. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with hand-painted stylized wood and cloth textures. The unit rests squarely on four integral corner feet with no extra plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden top surface with slightly protruding square corner caps, holding from one side to the other: a red wide-brimmed hat viewed top-down, a dark green folded cloth block, a cream rectangular folded fabric, and a rolled red cylinder of fabric.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.2 to 4.6 ft tall (reaching the upper chest/shoulder of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 2.5 ft wide, and 1.2 ft deep.

notes: footprint proportion 1.54x off the catalog (5.2 x 2.4 ft)
